about_the_game:
Land of Infinite Dreams is a single-player, story-driven adventure about Princess Luna — a young girl who escapes into Lunaria, a dreamworld shaped by loss, loneliness, and imagination.

After losing her mother at the age of ten, Luna feels abandoned when her father remarries. To cope with her solitude, she creates an imaginary world she can enter in her dreams — a realm that comes to life every full moon.

One fateful night, after a heated argument with the king, Luna falls asleep with a heavy heart. In her dream, she encounters the mysterious Black Witch, who offers her a chance to stay in Lunaria forever — an eternal escape from reality.

Explore surreal dreamscapes, solve meaningful puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden deep within Luna’s fading memories.

Key Features

  • A story-driven single-player experience
    Guide Princess Luna through a dreamlike world where every step is tied to emotion and memory. Explore, uncover secrets and shape the story through your choices.

  • Emotionally powerful narrative
    Experience a coming-of-age story rooted in grief, imagination, desperation and escapism. Navigate Luna’s inner world as she faces her loss and the temptation to abandon reality.

  • Stylized, dream-inspired visuals
    Journey through painterly 3D environments that shift and evolve with Luna’s emotions — from gentle wonder to eerie mystery.

  • Varied and meaningful puzzles
    Solve environmental and logic-based puzzles woven into the narrative. Each puzzle represents a piece of Luna’s fractured memories or emotions.

  • Light dreamworld combat
    Face off against shadowy dream-creatures — manifestations of Luna’s fears — using light combat mechanics that reflect her inner struggles.

  • Dialogue choices that shape the dream
    Interact with the imaginary inhabitants of Lunaria. Your dialogue choices may influence the world and unlock hidden paths. 

  • An original, evolving soundtrack
    Immerse yourself in a rich, emotional score that grows and shifts as Luna’s journey unfolds — from comfort to chaos, hope to healing.
